title: Astrid and the Witness
author: Gideon Dunmore
blurb: Lior Nakamura, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
